title: Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery Booking Rules and Charges Billed at Booking
content:
## 1. Who and what can be booked

1.1 A Marlowe & Finch Home Delivery service level can be booked only for the item types that level serves and for items up to that level's heaviest-item weight, at an address within that level's maximum service distance in road miles.

1.2 The earliest delivery date is the level's booking lead time, in business days, after the date the booking is made. Saturday is offered only at a level where Saturday delivery is offered.

1.3 The arrival window given to the customer is the level's arrival window length in hours.

## 2. Charges billed at booking

2.1 Charges are billed at booking, each as its own charge on the booking:

| Charge | Amount |
|---|---|
| Base delivery fee | The level's delivery fee, for up to the level's number of included items |
| Extra item fee | The level's extra item fee for each further item, that is, the greater of zero and the items on the booking less the included items, multiplied by the level's extra item fee |
| Stairs fee | The level's fee per extra flight for each flight of stairs at the address beyond the flights the level includes; a level whose fee per extra flight is not applicable does not carry items up stairs |
| Out-of-area surcharge | The level's surcharge per road mile for each road mile beyond the level's service area miles |
| Saturday surcharge | The level's Saturday surcharge, for a Saturday date |
| Haul-away fee | The level's haul-away fee, when haul-away is requested and is not included, for up to the level's maximum number of haul-away items |

2.2 At every service level the base fee is that level's delivery fee and the extra item charge is that level's extra item fee.

## 3. Finch Circle discount

3.1 Where the level's Finch Circle discount applies, the customer's Finch Circle home delivery discount percentage, of the Finch Circle tier held on the date the booking is made, is credited on each charge billed at booking, rounded half up to the cent, with the credit given for the reason of the loyalty discount, after the free-delivery threshold credit.

3.2 The discount is computed charge by charge: each charge billed at booking receives its own credit, each rounded to the cent on its own.

## 4. Worked example (hypothetical figures, not those of any service level)

Inputs: a service level with a delivery fee of $80.00 covering 3 items, an extra item fee of $15.00, 1 flight included at $25.00 per further flight, 75 service area miles at $2.50 per further mile; the booking has 5 items, 3 flights of stairs, an address 83 road miles away and a weekday date; no haul-away is requested; the order does not reach the free-delivery threshold; the customer's Finch Circle home delivery discount percentage on the booking date is 15 percent and the level's Finch Circle discount applies.

| Charge billed | Derivation | Charge | Finch Circle credit at 15 percent, rounded half up to the cent |
|---|---|---|---|
| Base delivery fee | Delivery fee | $80.00 | $12.00 |
| Extra item fee | 5 items less 3 included is 2; 2 multiplied by $15.00 | $30.00 | $4.50 |
| Stairs fee | 3 flights less 1 included is 2; 2 multiplied by $25.00 | $50.00 | $7.50 |
| Out-of-area surcharge | 83 miles less 75 is 8; 8 multiplied by $2.50 | $20.00 | $3.00 |

With a booking of 2 items, the greater of zero and 2 less 3 is zero, so no extra item fee is billed.

*Rounding illustration (hypothetical):* a 15 percent discount on a $37.50 charge is $5.625, which rounds half up to $5.63.
